body:
N991-p3-intervention-response-kernel-acquisition | First-contact dose interventions acquire a bounded response kernel without finite-mean kinetics

STATUS | Source-derived theorem and synthetic acquisition report; scoped review pending. No physical assay or hidden kinetic network was acquired.

EXACT CLAIM
Let a native experiment have an arbitrary possibly non-Markovian hidden path, finite terminal category B, and almost-surely finite stopping time. Before the first probe hit, a nonnegative dose vector c changes only independently driven competing capture clocks with predictable path susceptibilities b_j(t), under the stated dose-linearity and no-interference contract. If each integrated susceptibility A_j is finite almost surely (without a finite-mean or maximum-rate bound), then the no-hit outcome subprobabilities are K_b(c)=E[1{B=b} exp(-c·A)]. A weak mixed-dose challenge acquires the common continuity modulus L(h)=K_hit(h,...,h). A finite-net procedure can acquire uniform bounded-dose predictions and a set of compatible joint measures; it does not identify the hidden microscopic network or rates.

FIRST-CONTACT REPORTING EXTENSION
A source theorem allows arbitrary post-contact dynamics after an untagged contact if the persistent-tag probability q applies conditionally to relevant first contacts. This q is an instrument/design premise, not estimated by the synthetic data. For q<1 the actual response retains a bounded residual; the q=1 arbitrary-accuracy result is not transferred to the whole actual response by increasing repetitions or numerical degree.

SYNTHETIC SOURCE RECORD
The selected source describes a five-state hidden transient, two native categories, two probe channels, 12 dose arms and 12,000 categorical draws per arm (144,000 total; seed 2026102503). No physical data or terminal times were generated. The selected interval JSON states a 36-member simultaneous family. The source return lacked interception_operators.json and interception_contact_operators.json; this intake does not replay the fit or certify the reported dual/contact calculations from those unavailable operator artifacts.

LIMITS AND COMPARATORS
The finite-data procedure stops almost surely under its source contract but has no model-uniform experiment-count bound; the dose net is generally exponential in channel count and the smallest realizable dose can limit precision. The conditional first-contact coverage premise is not measured by these observations. No physical kinetics, novelty, optimal dose allocation, advantage, or superiority to nonparametric frailty, moment/SDP, imprecise-process, trajectory or tensor methods is established. This response kernel is distinct from N744's stationary flux polytope and does not validate its reset or microscopic-source contract.

EVIDENCE
The exact representation, finite-data construction, contact extension, synthetic observation configuration and intervals are indexed in the attached source index. Producer scripts were not run.
